sources_read.section: the leaf's register/paint contract and the painter
the hook to extend with a cursor store
the Stage children the layer mounts into

scope: A single presence provider/context, a cursor store on usePresence, a PresenceLayer that paints incoming cursors, a page pointer callback that publishes throttled/normalized cursors, and the page-stage/highlighted-page slots they need. Out of scope: a second channel; cursors in React state; the live measurement.

acceptance_criteria.text: One live channel; rail and layer both consume the provider's value (no second usePresence channel).
An incoming cursor paints through the leaf; unmount clears the paint; React state is untouched by cursors.
A pointer publishes page-relative 0-1 through geometry, at most once per interval and not on a repeat; a missing ids publishes nothing.
Tests for the provider value, the layer paint, and the publish normalisation/throttle.

open_questions: Q8 (unanswered: the real tablet mix) — the frame budget stays 015's follow-up; this task's gate is the live two-browser measurement.
RULE-17 (standing): the wire carries page-relative 0-1, so each client renders with its own displayed size/rotation; pixels never cross.
RULE-20 (standing): cursors are ref+paint only; the provider uses listeners, not state, to notify the layer.
risks: Two usePresence callers would open two channels; the provider is the single owner.
Publishing raw pixels would break a peer at another zoom/rotation; geometry normalises first.
A provider listener set must be cleared on unmount or a stale paint runs against a destroyed layer.
